entries.text: ORDER: Plaintiff shall serve the Complaint and summons on Defendants within ninety days of the filing of the Complaint. All parties must familiarize themselves with the Court's Individual Rules and Practices in Civil Pro Se Cases, which are attached to this Order and available at https://nysd.uscourts.gov/judge/Furman. The Clerk of the Court is directed to mail a copy of this Order to Plaintiff. (As further set forth herein.) (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 9/30/2026) (kgo) Order
Note Regarding Service on Self-Represented Party
Amended Standing Order re Pro Se Litigation
